2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing
Counsel for the State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the issue as raised in this
petition is infact squarely covered by the
decision of the Coordinate Bench dated
22.10.2019 passed in bunch of petitions, the
leading one is WPSS No.2177 of 2018, which
also attains finality but is not being
implemented uniformly and the official
respondents are adopting the pick and
choose method to comply the judgment of
the writ court.
4. Let Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned
Standing Counsel may get instruction by
14.10.2026 why the official respondents are
not implementing the judgment of the
Coordinate Bench, uniformly.
5. Put up on 14.10.2026 as fresh.
